status_note: I discarded these preliminary strict-grader budgets after repairing the measurement instrument. No confirmation answers were collected using this plan.
metric: Strict-format correct-answer probability under the committed prompts and output-token limits, not canonical benchmark accuracy.
generation_seed_rule: base + model_index*1000000 + (100000 for confirmation, else 0) + (10000 for ARC, else 0) + dataset_index; model_index follows protocol.models. Greedy decoding uses temperature zero.
interpretation: One fresh comparison per feasible model pair and benchmark. Shared model answers make detections dependent; observed detection fraction is not an independent estimate of a single pair's power.
